Renewal Deals Bar Graph — Visualization Guidance
Summary
The "show me in bar graph" request didn't return any rendered visualization — likely because there's no
specific dataset or filter attached to trigger the chart.
Based on the last query, try being explicit: "Show me all Renewal type deals by stage as a bar graph" or
"Bar graph of Renewal deals by owner and amount" — specifying the X and Y axes alongside the data
from freshsales_Deal.csv tends to produce the chart cleanly. The 25 Renewal deals across 5 stages we
just covered would make a compelling visual, especially comparing the $2.46M in Negotiation against
the $266K still in Prospecting.
